params.name: size
params.description: Number of returned courses per request.

params.description: The order of the list, must be a value from /courses/orderings

info.name: Query operation for courses

items.docs: Lists courses in the Pure instance that matches the provided query, similar to the GET version, instead of using parameters to alter the response, an JSON document is posted with the request. The JSON document contains fields for all the parameters available for the GET version, but also additional filtering options.
